Gem in Hội An!!
Sep 2026 • Family
I live in Singapore and ate in many Northern and Southern Indian restaurants there and abroad. 
Two year old Phirangg will soon become a Michelin Star restaurant! 
The best Aloo Gobhi I tasted so far is here! It’s Paneer is also the star of our meal today!! 
They have good crew and especially Dave who took time to explain about the history of their restaurant and its Danang Pioneer outlet RANG. 

I’ll be stopping by soon as a regular visitor to Hội An.
